question: Engineer's Day in India is celebrated in the memory of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. M. Visvesvaraya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Engineer's Day** in India is celebrated in the memory of **Dr. M. Visvesvaraya,** who was a** renowned engineer, scholar, and statesman.**
 
• Dr. M. Visvesvaraya was born on **September 15, 1861,** in **Muddenahalli near Bangalore** and is known for his contributions to the field of **engineering and nation-building.**
 
• He was awarded the** Bharat Ratna in 1955** and was also knighted by the **British government in 1915 **for his contributions to the Indian engineering industry.
 
• Dr. M. Visvesvaraya was the** chief engineer** responsible for the construction of the **Krishna Raja Sagara Dam **in **Mysore** and was also instrumental in the establishment of the University of Mysore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalpana Chawla** was an **Indian-American astronaut **who died in the **Space Shuttle Columbia disaster** in **2003.**
 
• **Satish Dhawan** was an **Indian aerospace scientist.**
 
• **A.P.J Abdul Kalam **was an Indian scientist and politician who served as the **11th President of India.**
